name: Forbidden Rendezvous
source:
A short pre-war TFP!MegOP story based on [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/22204186]Forbidden Rendezvous[/url], a Transformers fan-fiction written by [url=https://archiveofourown.org/users/leclairage/pseuds/perictione]perictione[/url].

[Edited from [url=https://useless19.itch.io/forbidden-rendezvous]Itch.io[/url]]
